prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit input image 1, the existing Simple Life wooden planter-bench. Input image 2 is camera/pixel-art guidance only, not an object to copy. Output ONE revised isolated asset for review.

RECONSTRUCT THE PHYSICAL FOOTPRINT AND CAMERA:
The central planting box is a long narrow rectangle whose LONG AXIS runs NORTH–SOUTH, straight VERTICALLY UP THE IMAGE. Its short near end is at the bottom, its short far end at the top. Two attached wooden bench seats run alongside its LEFT AND RIGHT LONG SIDES, parallel to that vertical long axis. They are long side seats, not little horizontal wings attached to the short ends. The whole assembly is a vertical garden seating unit with the box between the two seats. Its front short-end width is narrower than its projected front-to-back depth. Do not simply rotate the original bitmap, rotate the flower spikes sideways, or retain the original wide horizontal planter arrangement.

Keep a room-aligned ORTHOGRAPHIC angled top-down RPG projection, with straight horizontal width edges and straight vertical depth alignment. Raise the camera significantly to reveal a generous open soil bed, all upper planter rim surfaces, and broad usable upper surfaces of both long side seats. Clearly visible deep top planes, SHORTER shaded upright front faces, modest thin wood rims, attached vertical supports, naturally occluded rear supports. Reproject wood, seat tops, soil, leaves, flowers and posts coherently. No diagonal isometric rotation, no vanishing points, no eye-level furniture illustration, no exaggerated tall near wooden face. Image 2 shows the desired camera elevation and north–south seating orientation; make an original construction, not an exact copy.

PRESERVE THE DESIGN FAMILY:
Warm reddish-brown timber, clear square corner posts, sturdy wooden seat supports, restrained plank seams and a few deliberate grain marks. Retain the same flower selection: several upright purple flower spikes, olive/sage leafy clusters, and a few small cream flowers. Reorganize these naturally along the north–south soil bed with readable gaps of visible soil. Keep enough of the timber rim, corner joinery and seat tops uncovered to understand the construction. Preserve clean medium-detail pixel art with intentional clusters, thin warm dark-brown outlines, modest discrete material shades and upper-left light.

TRANSPARENCY AND ISOLATION:
Remove ALL glow, bloom, vignette, coloured halo, soft lighting haze, background shading and ground shadows. There must be no visible or translucent halo outside the hard-edged object silhouette, including under the seats or in the open gaps between supports. Genuine transparent alpha outside the asset, crisp unsmoothed pixel edges. No background, floor, pavement, grass, platform, characters, text, UI, label, watermark or other object. Keep the full object centered with transparent padding on all sides. No alternate designs, collage or multiple views. Preserve the full generated PNG resolution. Review only.
